name: Loblolly Pine

facts.what: Green needles for tea; inner bark in survival use
facts.where: The dominant pine of East Texas

caution: True-pine needle tea is safe and vitamin-rich, but pregnant women should avoid pine needle tea, and never use yew or other toxic evergreens: confirm a true pine. Never eat a wild plant on this guide's word alone. Confirm identity against several sources and learn the look-alikes first.

sections.title: Identification
sections.body: Long needles in bundles of three and big scaly cones. The workhorse pine of the East Texas timber belt.

sections.title: Uses
sections.body: A handful of chopped green needles steeped (not boiled) makes a piney, citrusy tea high in vitamin C.
